flags.text: The comments on PhaseObservingStateBody say the recorder 'has zero @Published properties' and must be wrapped to observe lifecycle; WorkoutRecorder and WorkoutLifecycle are both @Observable, so reading recorder.phase in FitnessTabView is already tracked and the wrapper rationale is stale.

The doc comment at the top says the view 'Owns the WorkoutRecorder as a @State so the recorder lives only while the tab is on screen', but the recorder lives in the app-wide RecorderBox singleton (dependencies.app.recorderBox).

flags.text: Swipe-dismissing the just-completed summary sheet goes through the binding setter, which only nils lastCompletedSession/selectedHistorySession and never calls recorder.acknowledgeFinished(). acknowledgeFinished is the only path (besides the Watch ack listener) that moves lifecycle.phase from .finished back to .idle and stops a lingering Polar stream, and WorkoutRecorder.start throws alreadyRecording unless phase is .idle — so the next Start shows 'Can't start workout' until the Watch acknowledges or the app relaunches. The sheet has no interactiveDismissDisabled.
